extracted.intended_audience: registrants (public companies), corporate counsel, SEC compliance officers, investor_relations_personnel
extracted.subtask_description: Regulation S-K Item 402—detailed disclosure requirements and tabular formats for executive and director compensation, equity awards, pension and deferred compensation, and termination/change-in-control payments for SEC filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant date columns for equity awards (columns (i)-(l))
rubrics_metrics.description: The grants of plan-based awards table must include: the number of shares of stock granted in the fiscal year not required to be disclosed in columns (f) through (h) (column (i)); the number of securities underlying options granted in the fiscal year not required to be disclosed in columns (f) through (h) (column (j)); the per-share exercise or base price of the options granted in the fiscal year (column (k)); and the grant date fair value of each equity award computed in accordance with FASB ASC Topic 718 (column (l)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If exercise/base price is less than closing market price on the date of grant, add an adjoining column showing the closing market price on the date of grant. If awards were repriced or materially modified, report the incremental fair value computed as of the repricing/modification date in accordance with ASC 718.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate line for each award and plan identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure on a separate line shall be provided in the Table for each grant of an award made to a named executive officer during the fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If grants were made under more than one plan, identify the particular plan under which each grant was made.

rubrics_metrics.name: Threshold, target, maximum definitions for incentive plan awards
rubrics_metrics.description: For grants of incentive plan awards, provide the information called for by columns (c),(d),(e) or (f),(g),(h) as applicable. For columns (c) and (f), 'threshold' refers to the minimum amount payable for a certain level of performance. For columns (d) and (g), 'target' refers to the amount payable if specified performance target(s) are reached. For columns (e) and (h), 'maximum' refers to the maximum payout possible under the plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the award provides only for a single estimated payout, that amount must be reported as the 'target'. In columns (d) and (g), if the target amount is not determinable, registrants must provide a representative amount based on the previous fiscal year's performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodology for determining exercise/base price when no market exists
rubrics_metrics.description: In determining if the exercise or base price of an option is less than the closing market price of the underlying security, the registrant may use either the closing market price specified or, if no market exists, any other formula prescribed for the security.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Whenever the exercise/base price reported in column (k) is not the closing market price, describe the methodology for determining the exercise/base price either by a footnote or accompanying textual narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tandem grant reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: A tandem grant of two instruments, only one of which is granted under an incentive plan (e.g., an option granted in tandem with a performance share), need be reported only in column (i) or (j), as applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For example, an option granted in tandem with a performance share would be reported only as an option grant in column (j), with the tandem feature noted either by a footnote or accompanying textual narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Footnote disclosure of consideration paid by executive
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose the dollar amount of consideration, if any, paid by the executive officer for the award in a footnote to the appropriate column.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantify non-equity incentive awards denominated in units
rubrics_metrics.description: If non-equity incentive plan awards are denominated in units or other rights, a separate, adjoining column between columns (b) and (c) shall be added quantifying the units or other rights awarded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting awards subject to repricing or material modification
rubrics_metrics.description: Options, SARs and similar option-like instruments granted in connection with a repricing transaction or other material modification shall be reported in this Table.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: However, disclosure does not apply to any repricing that occurs through a pre-existing formula or mechanism in the plan or award that results in periodic adjustment of exercise/base price, an antidilution provision, or a recapitalization or similar transaction equally affecting all holders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant-date valuation for performance-conditioned equity awards
rubrics_metrics.description: For any equity awards subject to performance conditions, report in column (l) the value at the grant date based upon the probable outcome of such conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This amount should be consistent with the estimate of aggregate compensation cost to be recognized over the service period determined as of the grant date under FASB ASC Topic 718, excluding the effect of estimated forfeitures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative disclosure to summary compensation and grants tables
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a narrative description of any material factors necessary to an understanding of the information disclosed in the tables required by paragraphs (c) and (d) of this Item.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include material terms of employment agreements (written or unwritten); descriptions of repricings or material modifications of outstanding awards; material terms of awards including formula/criteria for amounts payable and vesting schedules; descriptions of performance-based and market conditions per ASC 718; and explanation of the amount of salary and bonus in proportion to total compensation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outstanding equity awards at fiscal year-end table — required columns
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide, on an award-by-award basis, information concerning unexercised options; stock that has not vested; and equity incentive plan awards outstanding at fiscal year-end in the specified tabular format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table columns include: (a) name; (b) number of securities underlying unexercised options exercisable; (c) number unexercisable; (d) number of securities underlying unexercised unearned options; (e) option exercise price; (f) option expiration date; (g) number of shares/units not vested; (h) market value of shares/units not vested; (i) number of unearned shares/units/rights not vested (and number of shares underlying units if applicable); (j) market/payout value of unearned shares/units/rights not vested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Footnote: awards transferred other than for value
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify by footnote any award that has been transferred other than for value, disclosing the nature of the transfer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Footnote: vesting dates disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: The vesting dates of options, shares of stock and equity incentive plan awards held at fiscal-year end must be disclosed by footnote to the applicable column where the outstanding award is reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market value computation and performance-goal basis for outstanding awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute the market value of stock reported in column (h) and equity incentive plan awards of stock reported in column (j) by multiplying the closing market price of the registrant's stock at the end of the last completed fiscal year by the number of shares or units or amount of equity incentive awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The number of shares/units reported in columns (d) or (i), and the payout value in column (j), shall be based on achieving threshold performance goals, except if the previous fiscal year's performance exceeded the threshold (then base on the next higher measure). If award provides only a single estimated payout report that amount; if target not determinable provide representative amount based on previous fiscal year's performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aggregation and tranche reporting rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple awards may be aggregated where the expiration date and the exercise and/or base price of the instruments is identical.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A single award consisting of a combination of options, SARs and/or similar instruments shall be reported as separate awards with respect to each tranche with a different exercise/base price or expiration date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting change of status when performance condition satisfied
rubrics_metrics.description: Options or stock awarded under an equity incentive plan are reported in columns (d) or (i) and (j), respectively, until the relevant performance condition has been satisfied.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once satisfied, even if still subject to forfeiture conditions, options are reported in column (b) or (c) until exercised/expired, and stock is reported in columns (g) and (h) until it vests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Option exercises and stock vested table — required columns
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide aggregated information for each named executive officer on each exercise of stock options, SARs and similar instruments, and each vesting of stock during the last completed fiscal year in the tabular format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table columns include: name (a); number of securities for which options were exercised (b); aggregate dollar value realized upon exercise/transfer for value (c); number of shares that vested (d); aggregate dollar value realized upon vesting/transfer for value (e).

rubrics_metrics.name: Computation of value realized on exercise or vesting
rubrics_metrics.description: Report in column (c) the aggregate dollar amount realized by the named executive officer upon exercise of options or upon transfer of an award for value by calculating the difference between the market price at exercise and the exercise/base price; and in column (e) report aggregate dollar amount realized upon vesting by multiplying number of shares/units by market value on vesting date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not include the value of any related payment or other consideration provided by the registrant to or on behalf of the officer (such payments are disclosed elsewhere). For deferred receipt amounts, provide a footnote quantifying the amount and disclosing deferral terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pension benefits table — columns and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide information for each plan that provides payments or other benefits at, following, or in connection with retirement in the tabular format including: name; plan name; number of years credited service; present value of accumulated benefit; payments during last fiscal year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pension valuation assumptions and narrative disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the same assumptions used for financial reporting under GAAP, except assume retirement age is plan normal retirement age (or earliest unreduced retirement age if not defined). Disclose valuation method and all material assumptions applied in quantifying present value of accrued benefit in accompanying textual narrative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrants may satisfy this disclosure by reference to financial statements/footnotes or MD&A; those sections are deemed part of the disclosure. For allocating accrued benefit between qualified plans and related supplemental plans, apply IRC limitations as of the pension plan measurement date. If credited service differs from actual years, provide footnote quantifying difference and any benefit augmentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative description of material factors for pension plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a succinct narrative description of any material factors necessary to an understanding of each plan covered by the tabular disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: material terms and conditions of payments/benefits (normal retirement formula/eligibility); early retirement eligibility and formulas; specific compensation elements included in applying benefit formula; purposes for multiple plans; registrant policies on granting extra years of credited service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonqualified deferred compensation table — required columns
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide for each nonqualified defined contribution or other nonqualified deferred compensation plan information including: executive contributions in last FY; registrant contributions in last FY; aggregate earnings in last FY; aggregate withdrawals/distributions; aggregate balance at last fiscal year end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table must include the executive's name and the dollar amounts for each column as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Footnote linking deferred compensation to Summary Compensation Table
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a footnote quantifying the extent to which amounts reported in the contributions and earnings columns are reported as compensation in the last completed fiscal year in the registrant's Summary Compensation Table and the extent to which aggregate balance at fiscal year end previously were reported as compensation in prior years' Summary Compensation Tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative on material terms of deferred compensation plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a succinct narrative description of any material factors necessary to an understanding of each deferred compensation plan covered by the tabular disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: types of compensation permitted to be deferred and any limitations; measures for calculating interest/earnings (including whether measures selected by executive or registrant and frequency/manner of changes), quantifying interest rates and measures applicable during last fiscal year; material terms with respect to payouts, withdrawals and distributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential payments upon termination or change-in-control — required disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Regarding each contract, agreement, plan or arrangement that provides for payments to a named executive officer in connection with termination (resignation, severance, retirement, constructive termination) or change in control, describe and explain specified elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically: (1) describe specific circumstances that trigger payments/benefits; (2) describe and quantify estimated payments/benefits in each covered circumstance, indicate lump sum or annual, duration, and provider; (3) describe/explain how payment/benefit levels are determined; (4) describe/explain material conditions/obligations applicable to receipt of payments (non-compete, non-solicitation, non-disparagement, confidentiality), including duration and waiver provisions; (5) describe any other material factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assumptions and estimation instructions for termination/change-in-control disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Quantitative disclosure must apply assumptions that the triggering event took place on the last business day of the registrant's last completed fiscal year and that price per share equals closing market price on that date. If uncertainties exist, registrant must make reasonable estimate or range and disclose material assumptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perquisites and other personal benefits may be excluded only if aggregate amount is less than $10,000. For health care benefits quantify using GAAP assumptions. Cross-reference to other paragraphs (h) or (i) is permitted if those disclosures fully cover the form/amount; enhancements or accelerations must be separately disclosed. If triggering event occurred and the named officer was not serving at FY-end, disclosure applies only to that triggering event. Contracts that do not discriminate in favor of executive officers and are generally available to all salaried employees need not be disclosed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director compensation table — required columns
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following tabular information concerning compensation of directors for the last completed fiscal year: Fees earned/paid in cash; Stock awards (grant-date fair value); Option awards (grant-date fair value); Non-equity incentive plan compensation; Change in pension value and nonqualified deferred compensation earnings; All other compensation; Total.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include director names (unless director is also a named executive officer whose director compensation is shown in the Summary Compensation Table).

rubrics_metrics.name: Director equity award footnote disclosure (ASC 718)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each director, disclose by footnote the grant date fair value of each equity award computed in accordance with FASB ASC Topic 718; for any option/SAR where exercise/base price was adjusted or award repriced or materially modified during the last completed fiscal year, disclose incremental fair value computed as of the repricing/modification date per ASC 718; and disclose the aggregate number of stock awards and option awards outstanding at fiscal year end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exceptions for repricings via pre-existing formulas, antidilution provisions, or recapitalizations equally affecting holders do not require incremental-fair-value disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition and required items for 'All other compensation' for directors
rubrics_metrics.description: All other compensation includes any compensation not reportable in other columns and must include items such as perquisites and personal benefits (subject to thresholds), gross-ups for tax payments, compensation cost for discounted security purchases (unless discount broadly available), amounts paid in connection with resignation/retirement/change-in-control, registrant contributions to defined contribution plans, consulting fees, costs of director legacy/charitable award programs, life insurance premiums paid by registrant, and dividends/earnings on stock/option awards not factored into grant-date fair value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each item not properly reportable in other columns must be included in 'All other compensation' regardless of amount. Perquisites/personal benefits may be excluded unless aggregate is $10,000 or more; if $10,000 or more each perquisite must be identified; if any perquisite exceeds greater of $25,000 or 10% of total perquisites it must be quantified and a methodology for computing aggregate incremental cost disclosed. Reimbursements of taxes on perquisites must be included and separately quantified as tax reimbursements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total compensation for directors
rubrics_metrics.description: The dollar value of total compensation (column (h)) is the sum of all amounts reported in columns (b) through (g).

rubrics_metrics.name: Grouping directors with identical compensation
rubrics_metrics.description: Two or more directors may be grouped in a single row in the Table if all elements of their compensation are identical.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The names of the directors for whom grouped disclosure is presented should be clear from the Table.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative to director compensation table
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a narrative description of any material factors necessary to an understanding of the director compensation disclosed in the Table.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include descriptions of standard compensation arrangements (retainers, committee/chairman fees, meeting attendance) and identification/description of any director with a different compensation arrangement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scaled disclosure for smaller reporting and emerging growth companies
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant that qualifies as a 'smaller reporting company' or as an 'emerging growth company' may provide the scaled disclosure specified in paragraphs (m)-(r) instead of paragraphs (a)-(k),(s), and (u) of this Item.

rubrics_metrics.name: All-compensation coverage requirement for smaller reporting companies
rubrics_metrics.description: Smaller reporting companies must provide clear, concise and understandable disclosure of all plan and non-plan compensation awarded to, earned by, or paid to the named executive officers and directors by any person for all services rendered in all capacities to the smaller reporting company and its subsidiaries, unless specifically excluded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All such compensation shall be reported pursuant to this Item, even if also called for by another requirement, including transactions between the smaller reporting company and a third party where a purpose of the transaction is to furnish compensation to any such named executive officer or director.
